channel.display-name: In The Heat Of The Night

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: The iconic series that turned Duane Dog Chapman into a household name. Follow Dog and his crew as they track down fugitives who have jumped bail. Then get up close and personal as they encourage criminals to turn their lives around and start a new life.

programme.title: Doomed Caravan
programme.desc: Who would ever mistake Roy Rogers for Billy the Kid? That's exactly what happens in this actionpacked horse opera from Republic Pictures. Rogers arrives on the scene shortly after Pat Garrett (Wade Boteler) kills the infamous Billy the Kid (also played by Rogers). Though Billy was a killer, he was on the side of the homesteaders against a coterie of big time ranchers. As Billy's death is unknown to the public, Roy gets Garrett to let him pose as Billy to continue the fight against the ranchers, but without the bloodshed. We also get six songs, including When the Sun is Setting on the Prairie...

programme.title: Tuesday Night Pickleball
programme.desc: Experience the intense "Final Four" showdown at the 2024 DUPR Collegiate National Championship as the rising FAU Owls challenge the two-time reigning champion UNC Tar Heels. The match hums with "Racing" energy as FAU utilizes a high-pressure "shake and bake" strategy, driving the ball with exceptional power right off the bat to catch the champions off guard. The elite "Skills" of UNC are on full display as they counter with patient resets and clinical "third, fifth, and seventh shot drops" to reclaim control of the kitchen. High-stakes "Freestyle" play keeps the crowd on edge, featuring gutsy lobs, precision spin drops, and heart-pounding rallies that define the very best of collegiate pickleball.

programme.sub-title: 'Para mentir y comer pescado, hay que tener mucho cuidado'
